answer_1.quote: Text Style Transfer can be thought of as a form of Controllable Language Generation ... We introduce the SA-MLM, a modification of the standard MLM, which we show is capable of performing TST by using a style-masked input and performing a simple same-style reconstruction task with a lightweight Transformer Encoder block.
answer_1.outputs: style-transferred sentences (e.g., changed sentiment or discourse relation)

answer_2.quote: Typically, metrics for style transfer include Style Transfer Accuracy (using a pretrained classifier), BLEU for content preservation, and perplexity (using a pretrained LM) to check the fluency of outputs. ... we also report METEOR, ROUGE-L and Naturalness scores.

answer_4.quote: Three volunteers were given the task of voting on 200 instances (equally split for the E to C and C to E task) from the test set. A vote consists of four options, i.e., "Model 1 better", "Model 2 better" or "Both Good", "Both Bad" ... As seen in Table ..., the SA-MLM performs better in both tasks by a significant margin.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators voted which model's output was better, both good, or both bad for each instance.
